title: L4-L5 ROM with bilateral PEEK rod pedicle-screw fixation (Gornet 2011)
subcategory: destabilised + bilateral PEEK rods (LPR) with pedicle screws at L4-L5
condition: destabilised + bilateral PEEK rods (LPR) with pedicle screws at L4-L5

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: L4-L5 segmental range of motion (total over both directions: flexion+extension, left+right LB, left+right AR) measured within an L1-sacrum specimen; bar value = mean (assumed), sd = whisker length (error-bar type not stated)

source.authors: Gornet MF, Chan FW, Coleman JC, Murrell B, Nockels RP, Taylor BA, Lanman TH, Ochoa JA
source.sample: 5 specimens (fresh-frozen L1-sacrum spines; instrumented level L4-L5); 5 fresh-frozen human cadaveric lumbar spines L1-sacrum, radiographically screened to exclude disc degeneration, minimal-mild facet hypertrophy, no osteopenia

protocol.summary: L1 and sacrum potted (bone cement + pins); sacrum on 6-component load cell, L1 free (unconstrained). Pure moments applied to L1 by water-filled bags on loading arms, continuous cycling between endpoints: flexion 8 Nm, extension 6 Nm (with 450 N follower load, Patwardhan technique), lateral bending +/-6 Nm and axial rotation +/-5 Nm (no follower load). Data collected until two reproducible load-displacement loops (max 3 cycles); rate not reported. L4 and L5 motion relative to sacrum by Optotrak. Test sequence on each specimen: intact -> destabilised (partial discectomy + hemi-facetectomy at L4-L5) -> bilateral PEEK rods (LPR, Medtronic) -> bilateral 5.5 mm titanium rods (same 4 pedicle screws).
how_to_simulate: Model L1-sacrum, fix the sacrum, leave L1 free
Flexion-extension: 450 N follower load + pure moment to L1, 8 Nm flexion and 6 Nm extension
Lateral bending +/-6 Nm and axial rotation +/-5 Nm without follower load
Condition: destabilised + bilateral PEEK rods (LPR) with pedicle screws at L4-L5
Report L4-L5 total ROM per plane (sum of both directions)
protocol.notes: ROM measured at L4-L5 inside a multi-segment specimen (not an isolated FSU). Asymmetric flexion/extension moments (8/6 Nm). Only the cadaveric ROM is extracted (device ASTM tests and FE results skipped).  Results text: ROM reduction vs intact (mean of specimens) flexion_extension_total 80%, lateral_bending_total 71%, axial_rotation_total 55% (p<0.001 each); no significant difference between PEEK and titanium.

data.load: 8 Nm flexion / 6 Nm extension + 450 N follower

extraction.from: Fig 8 (bar chart; bar = presumably mean, one-sided whisker = error bar of unstated type, presumably SD); Results text for % reductions
extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.05 deg (1 px = 0.019 deg; whisker read +/-0.05 deg)
extraction.check_notes: Page rendered at 250 dpi; axis calibrated on 8 tick marks (0-14 deg, 53.7 px/deg); bar tops and whisker caps found by column scan. Re-digitised visually at display scale: FE intact 8.82/11.41, LB intact 7.40/8.90, AR destab 5.00/6.70 - within 0.05 deg. Cross-check with text reductions vs intact: FE titanium 1.32/8.83 -> 85% (text 85%), PEEK 1.51/8.83 -> 83% (text 80%); LB Ti 85% (text 83%), PEEK 73% (text 71%); AR Ti 65% (text 66%), PEEK 58% (text 55%) - text values are means of per-specimen % and need not equal ratios of means. | verified 2026-11-12 sign check: OK (Fig 8 p7 image: total ROMs, all positive; bar/whisker values consistent)
